ZCam = ZCam*dec_f + (1-dec_f)* (ZVog-reg05); //# bei grosser YVog reduzieren
//YVog = 1; XVog = 0; ZVog = 0;xang = .0; yang = 0; zang = 0; XCam = 0; YCam = 1; ZCam = -2;
mx = ox*reg24 - oy*reg25; my = ox*reg25 + oy*reg24;
perFrameInitCode: power = 1; speed = 1; XVog = rand(6)-3; YVog = 1; ZVog = rand(4)-2;
